name: light-aircraft
description: A high-wing single-engine propeller aeroplane: a cowled nose with air inlets and exhaust, a cabin with windscreen, side windows, door frames and seats inside, strut-braced tapered wings with flaps and ailerons, a tailplane with elevators, a swept fin with dorsal fillet and rudder, a twisted two-blade propeller with spinner, fixed tricycle gear with wheel fairings, a two-colour cheat line, nav lights and a beacon.

params.name: length
params.description: Fuselage length in metres (a Cessna 172 is about 8.3).
